video_title: Should You Use Cursor? 60-Second IDE Guide
voiceover_script: Looking for the perfect code editor? Today on IDE Guide, we're testing Cursor! An AI-first code editor fork of VS Code with deeply integrated AI codebase context and instant edits. Pricing model is Freemium (Free tier available, $20/mo Pro). Top strengths include Superior multi-file AI context indexing, Composer agent mode for building features. However, keep in mind Usage caps on expensive AI models. Best suited for Developers seeking maximum AI-assisted velocity and rapid prototyping.
